_comment: Chipdb overlay for GW5A-25A IOLOGIC OREG path. Bits extracted from Gowin micro-corpus via per-pin localized feature diff (codex methodology, job a62f21d0). Each entry: when the listed predicate is true for an encoded IOLOGIC cell at the matching ttyp+bel, also set the listed extra bits at the cell's tile.

overlays.description: Bits set at ttyp 247 IOLOGIC[A|B] when output FF is present, attributed via obuf_direct vs obuf_dff diff at pins A1+B2 (both slot A, ttyp 247)
Bits set at ttyp 247 IOLOGIC[A|B] when output FF is CE-enabled (DFFCE), attributed via obuf_dff vs obuf_dffce diff at pins A1+B2
Bits set at ttyp 247 IOLOGIC[A|B] when IOBUF (bidirectional) vs OBUF, attributed via obuf_dff vs iobuf_dff diff at pins A1+B2
overlays.confidence: HIGH (cross-pin consistent, matches Gowin EXP_HH R37C4 bit (31,78) which had longval ref)

overlays.description: Bits set at ttyp 245 IOLOGIC[A|B] when OE is registered, attributed via iobuf_dff vs iobuf_dff_oeff diff at pins G1+K4 (col-92 IOBs)
overlays.confidence: MEDIUM (TREG attr emission not yet wired into apicula encoder, predicate placeholder)
